description: Source code for a Git daemon implementation, handling network connections, repository access, and service management.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the daemon command, parsing arguments and starting server or inetd mode.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Sets up listening sockets and drops privileges, then enters service loop.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles a single connection, reading commands and dispatching services.

methods.name: parse_host_and_port
methods.description: Parses host and port from a string, handling IPv6 notation.

methods.name: sanitize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes client input for filesystem paths, disallowing directory traversal.

methods.name: canonicalize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes and lowercases client input for filesystem paths.

methods.name: lookup_hostname
methods.description: Resolves hostname to canonical name and IP address.

methods.name: hostinfo_clear
methods.description: Clears hostinfo buffers.

methods.name: set_keep_alive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive on socket.

methods.name: logerror
methods.description: Logs an error message.

methods.name: loginfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message if verbose is enabled.

methods.name: daemon_die
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by logging and exiting.

methods.name: path_ok
methods.description: Validates and returns a repository path if accessible and permitted.

methods.name: run_service
methods.description: Runs a specified git service after validation.

methods.name: run_access_hook
methods.description: Runs an external hook script for access control.

methods.name: enable_service
methods.description: Enables a named service.

methods.name: make_service_overridable
methods.description: Sets whether a service can be overridden.

methods.name: parse_extra_args
methods.description: Parses additional arguments from client input.

methods.name: child_handler
methods.description: Signal handler for child process termination.

methods.name: service_loop
methods.description: Main loop accepting and handling incoming connections.

methods.name: socksetup
methods.description: Sets up listening sockets based on configuration.

methods.name: setup_named_sock
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket for listening.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Tracks a child process and its socket address.

methods.name: kill_some_child
methods.description: Kills a duplicate connection when max connections are exceeded.

methods.name: check_dead_children
methods.description: Reaps terminated child processes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming connection, spawning a child process.
